findings.evidence: `IID.lean` lines 57–91 proves `MixedIIDWith.of_iIndepFun_identDistrib` and `Exchangeable.of_iIndepFun_identDistrib` without a probability instance and installs `hindep.isProbabilityMeasure`; Mathlib `Independence/Kernel/IndepFun.lean:416` provides `iIndepFun.indepFun_finset₀` for `AEMeasurable`, and `Measure/Map.lean:156` provides `map_apply_of_aemeasurable`.
findings.fix: Remove the probability typeclass from both declarations using `h_indep.isProbabilityMeasure`; make the cylinder lemma accept `∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ` via `indepFun_finset₀`/`map_apply_of_aemeasurable`, and derive that hypothesis in Hewitt–Savage from `(hident i).aemeasurable_fst`, eliminating `hX`.
findings.issue: `hewittSavage_trivial_of_iIndep` unnecessarily requires `[IsProbabilityMeasure μ]` and measurable representatives `hX`; the same redundant probability assumption and overly strong measurability occur in `measure_pathLaw_inter_cylinder_of_disjoint` at line 165.

summary: The i.i.d. entry points impose redundant probability and pointwise-measurability assumptions beyond the existing independence/identical-distribution API.
